using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Migration.Tests
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<MigrateOperation> _mockMigrateOperation;

        public MigrateSessionTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            _mockMigrateOperation = new Mock<MigrateOperation>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_SuccessfulSetSlotRange_LogsTraceCompletionMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>(); // Assuming interface or using refactor if needed
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(Task.FromResult("OK"));
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);
            
            // Mock CheckConnectionAsync to return true
            // Note: This would require making CheckConnectionAsync virtual or using refactor tool if needed

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node123", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT") && v.ToString().Contains("node123")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_SetSlotRangeReturnsError_LogsErrorAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(Task.FromResult("-ERROR some error"));
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node123", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange error:")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, session.Status);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_OperationCanceledException_LogsTimeoutError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Throws(new OperationCanceledException());
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(null, MigrateState.NODE);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("timed out or was cancelled")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, session.Status);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_GeneralException_LogsException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node123", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex.Message == "Test exception")),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, session.Status);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TryRecoverFromFailureAsync_FailedSetSlotRanges_LogsRecoveryError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(Task.FromResult("-ERROR"));
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TryRecoverFromFailureAsync();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("RecoverFromFailure failed to make slots STABLE")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        private MigrateSession CreateMigrateSession(ILogger<MigrateSession> logger, MigrateOperation migrateOperation)

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Migration.Tests
{
    public class MigrateSessionLoggerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<MigrateOperation> _mockMigrateOperation;
        private readonly Mock<IClusterClient> _mockClient; // Assuming client type

        public MigrateSessionLoggerTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            _mockMigrateOperation = new Mock<MigrateOperation>();
            _mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_SuccessPath_LogsCompletionTrace()
        {
            // Arrange
            SetupClientForSuccess();
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(_mockClient.Object);

            // Create real instance with mocked dependencies (simplified)
            var session = new FakeMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object)
            {
                Status = MigrateState.STABLE,
                _sslots = new[] { 1, 2, 3 },
                _slotRanges = new List<SlotRange>(),
                _timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                _cts = new CancellationTokenSource()
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("targetNode", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert - specifically verify the completion LogTrace call on line ~50
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogTrace(
                    "[Completed] SETSLOT {slots} {state} {nodeid}",
                    It.Is<string[]>(slots => slots.SequenceEqual(new[] { "1-3" })), // ClusterManager.GetRange result
                    It.Is<MigrateState>(state => state == MigrateState.STABLE),
                    "targetNode"),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_NonOKResult_LogsErrorBeforeCompletionTrace()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(Task.FromResult("-MOVED 12001 127.0.0.1:3001"));
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(_mockClient.Object);

            var session = new FakeMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object)
            {
                _sslots = new[] { 1 },
                _slotRanges = new List<SlotRange>(),
                _timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                _cts = new CancellationTokenSource()
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(null, MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert - Error logged, NO completion trace
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError("SetSlotRange error: {error}", "-MOVED 12001 127.0.0.1:3001"),
                Times.Once);
            
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogTrace("[Completed] SETSLOT {slots} {state} {nodeid}", It.IsAny<object[]>(), It.IsAny<MigrateState>(), It.IsAny<string>()),
                Times.Never); // Completion trace NOT called

            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TryRecoverFromFailureAsync_FailurePath_LogsRecoveryError()
        {
            // Arrange
            SetupClientForFailure();
            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(_mockClient.Object);

            var session = new FakeMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object)
            {
                _sslots = new[] { 1 },
                _slotRanges = new List<SlotRange>(),
                _timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                _cts = new CancellationTokenSource()
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TryRecoverFromFailureAsync();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError("MigrateSession.RecoverFromFailure failed to make slots STABLE"),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        private void SetupClientForSuccess()
        {
            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(Task.FromResult("OK"));
        }

        private void SetupClientForFailure()
        {
            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(Task.FromResult("-ERROR"));
        }
    }

    // Test double to expose protected members and mock private dependencies
    public class FakeMigrateSession : MigrateSession
    {
        public FakeMigrateSession(ILogger<MigrateSession> logger, MigrateOperation migrateOperation) : base(/* simplified constructor args */)
        {
            this.logger = logger;
            this.migrateOperation = new[] { migrateOperation };
        }

        public MigrateState Status { get; set; } = MigrateState.STABLE;
        public int[] _sslots;
        public List<SlotRange> _slotRanges = new();
        public TimeSpan _timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
        public CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();

        // Mock CheckConnectionAsync
        public override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(IClusterClient client) => Task.FromResult(true);

        // Override static call for testing
        protected override string[] GetSlotRange() => _sslots?.Select(s => s.ToString()).ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<string>();
    }
}
